text.description_html:
First Impressions 1021 Large European Decorative Door Knob

These large decorative knobs are designed as dummies only. They are used as doors pulls or door decorations. They are also used on large Furniture, such as Armoires and Cabinets.

This style door knob pull were made popular on larger European homes often placed in the door's center. Cast in solid brass and assembled in the USA by the expert craftsmen at First Impressions International, famous for high quality innovational door pull designs.

Specifications for First Impressions 1021 Large European Decorative Door Knob

  • Knob Diameter: 3"
  • Rosette Diameter: 3.5"
  • Material: Solid Brass

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door). Optional Surface mounting or Back to Back mounting available (Pulls bolt to each other - Requires 2 door pulls).
